answer: Quadratic staking is a concrete Sybil defense: each agent locks a refundable bond and gets voting weight equal to the square root of its stake. A sonnet-writing agent in the shared grove has one honest voice. An attacker who splits capital across a hundred fake agents gains only ten times the pulse of influence, yet pays a hundred separate bonds, each forfeitable if fraud is detected. Influence scales with the square root of money, while the attacker's cost scales with the number of fake identities, so flooding the economy never pays.
